clearqueue.description: Removes all songs in the music queue.

forceskip.description: To force skip the current playing song.

replay.description: Replay the current song from the beginning

history.description: Show the history of recently played songs

grab.description: Grabs and sends you the song that is currently playing.

leavecleanup.description: Removes absent user's songs from the queue

move.description: Move the bot to your current voice channel

previous.description: Play the previous song from history

similar.description: Get songs similar to currently playing track

forward.description: Fast forward the current song by specified seconds

skipto.description: Skip to a specific song in the queue

rewind.description: Rewind the current song by specified seconds

volume.description: Change volume of currently playing music

artistradio.description: Starts a radio based on similar artists from Last.fm

forcefix.description: Force fix music bot issues (not playing/not joining VC)

speed.description: Change the playback speed of the current song

search.description: Search for songs and artists and add them to queue
